name: OpenVibe.Help
tagline: Answers, support and a way to reach people.
description: OpenVibe.Help is the help centre for every OpenVibe site: what each site does and whether it is live, the common questions each one answers about itself, search across all of them, and a support ticket that stays one conversation with the people who run OpenVibe. Next: answers from the docs, wiki and status pages, and a Report Problem button on every site.

pillars.title: Answers from the sites
pillars.text: Each product's own manifest, word for word, with a link back to where it was read.

pillars.title: One search
pillars.text: One box over every site's answers and over the whole OpenVibe network.

pillars.title: Tickets
pillars.text: Signed in, open a ticket and it stays one conversation with the people who run the site.

pillars.title: Every site in one place
pillars.text: Live sites first, each with its own words, its own questions and what shipped on it.

faq.question: Where do the answers come from?
faq.answer: From each OpenVibe site's own description of itself, kept word for word, with a link to where it was read. Nothing is written by an AI.

faq.question: How do I reach a person?
faq.answer: Sign in with your OpenVibe account and open a ticket. Replies stay in one conversation that only you and OpenVibe staff can read.

faq.question: Do I need an account to read the help centre?
faq.answer: No. Reading and searching are open to everyone; only tickets need an account.

faq.question: Which sites does it cover?
faq.answer: Every OpenVibe product site, live or coming, from OpenVibe.Live to OpenRestream. Each one has its own page with its questions and where it lives.

keywords: openvibe help, openvibe support, help center, support tickets, troubleshooting
